title: From Borges' Library to Procedural Universes: A Formal Framework for Navigability and Limits in Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 把 LLM 形式化为可导航的'过程库'
contributions.mechanism: 定义 procedural library 三元组 + operator calculus,证明 typical-set suppression 与 operator 熵单调下降
contributions.evaluation: 定性:AEP 型集中界 + 条件熵 H(X|Z)≤H(X)(理论,无数值)
contributions.source_quote: A formal definition of procedural libraries and an operator calculus that reduces conditional entropy

contributions.purpose: 刻画可导航性与命中成本
contributions.mechanism: navigability index、hitting time、best-of-N 改进、energy-per-hit 下界、Blackwell 单调性
contributions.source_quote: navigability metrics with hitting-time and energy bounds

contributions.purpose: 刻画幻觉的结构性下界与不可能性
contributions.mechanism: 幻觉风险分解 HR≥(1-c)(1-α)+cβ;SAT 归约复杂度下界;No-Free-Lunch;conformal 可靠性界
contributions.evaluation: 定性:除非 c=1 且 β=0 否则 HR>0;NP⊆BPP 否则指数命中时间
contributions.source_quote: an information-theoretic decomposition of hallucination risk and complexity-theoretic lower bounds

notes: accept。GPT-5 署名+真实作者(SCCH, Kopetzky)。checklist AI 披露:假设/实验/分析/写作全 D(全自主,含 SORA 视频)。非实证类适配问题突出:全部'定理'实为经典结果换 LLM 说法的 proof sketch——AEP/Shannon-McMillan、Blackwell 充分性、Nemhauser 子模贪心 1-1/e、conformal prediction 均直接搬用,checklist theory proofs 自认[No](仅 proof sketch+理想化假设)。实证为玩具:12 题 QA,BASE 已 100% 正确导致 FEWSHOT/RAG 无法真正评估(自认 Limitations);RAG p_f=0.67、HR≥0.22。无 error bars(N=12,自认[No])。无明确 extend/adapt/replace X 语句(建立在 Borges 概念+信息论之上但未声明替代具体工作)。
